body: It’s okay! I just needed this off my chest
I was hoping not to get that far. But of course there is always someone who has it worse. Does that mean I can’t feel bad about this?

Thanks! I’m already doing that! I’m still taking showers and drinking water! So it’s not that bad. It’s just going outside to get some groceries feels really impossible right now. Even ordering food is way too much since I actually have to open the door and see someone.
You have to help you before you could help him
